messages:
Tom - Growth: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — three asks re: pipeline triage & partner playbook. who owns close-stage partner handoffs, what SLA should we promise for enablement, and timeline for partner-facing templates? tagging @Marta @Priya @Elena for input.
Marta - Partnerships: thanks Tom. I can own the handoff doc + runbook (sales -> partner success). proposal: standardize a 3-step handoff: 1) intro call, 2) technical enablement, 3) co-sell kickoff. SLA target: 10 business days for enablement after contract sign, unless customer requests fast-track. thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Elena - Sales Ops: 10 days seems reasonable as a default. operationally we need a flag in CRM to mark "partner-handoff" and a new webhook to notify Partnerships. I can scope the CRM change — will need 1 sprint to implement and a small training doc for AEs.
Priya - Product: for partner-facing templates, engineering can ship a thin template pack in 2 sprints if we limit to 3 templates: partner intro deck, integration checklist, and demo script. if Partnerships wants custom variants we should scope later. also want to align on ownership of template updates.
Tom - Growth: good — can we make the 3-step handoff the default in the playbook and include the 10-day SLA? also, can we add a clear trigger for the webhook so AEs know when to set the flag?
Marta - Partnerships: yes to default. for triggers: contract signed (stage=Closed-Won) + channel=partner-sourced or deal.tag=partner. that should cover most cases.
Elena - Sales Ops: I'll draft the CRM rule as: ``WHEN deal.stage == 'closed_won' AND deal.source == 'partner' THEN set deal.flag = 'partner-handoff'`` and add webhook to the partnerships queue. sharing PR in #eng-workflows by EOD.
Jamal - Eng: FYI on webhook — we can add an endpoint in Partnerships service; low-risk. timeline: 3 business days to add endpoint + auth check, then Elena's migration. if we need retries, add a dead-letter queue.
Priya - Product: timeline for templates: design review next Wed, engineering slots Thurs/Fri of next week, ship as a beta package to partners in ~2 weeks.
Chris (CEO): high-level: this sounds like the right prioritization. make the playbook change and CRM flag our default for partner-sourced deals. prioritize enablement SLA automation — manual handoffs are costing time. pleased to see defined timelines.
Marta - Partnerships: action items from me: draft playbook update, runbook for handoff, and a short enablement checklist. aim to share drafts by Tue next week.
Elena - Sales Ops: action items: CRM rule PR, webhook spec, training snippet for AEs. will sync with Marta on triggers.
Tom - Growth: I'll coordinate partner comms and update the partner onboarding checklist with the new timeline.
all-hands-bot: Meeting follow-up: slides + recording uploaded: https://redwood.company/all-hands/1734506789. Please add any follow-ups as comments on the doc.
Tom - Growth: perfect, thanks everyone. can we reconvene for a 15min triage on Friday to confirm PRs and templates? :thumbsup:
Marta - Partnerships: Friday works for me.
Priya - Product: ok for me.
Elena - Sales Ops: +1.
Jamal - Eng: I'll be there to confirm the webhook changes.
Tom - Growth: closing thread — I'll send a calendar invite for Fri 10:00am PT and list the action items. appreciate the quick responses! :rocket:
